autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 浮层被遮挡时是否自动调整方向。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether the popup flips its direction automatically when it is covered.

autofocus.zh-CN: 挂载后是否自动聚焦输入框。
autofocus.en-US: Whether the input is focused on mount.

autoSwitchDate.zh-CN: 通过面板上方的年月切换按钮或下拉菜单更改年月时，自动切换日期。仅对 date 类型生效。
autoSwitchDate.en-US: When the year or month is changed with the navigation buttons or dropdowns at the top of the panel, the date switches automatically. Only applies to the date type.

bottomSlot.zh-CN: 渲染底部额外区域，传入 JSX 元素。
bottomSlot.en-US: Renders an extra area at the bottom. Takes a JSX element.

class.en-US: Class name of the root element.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 自定义清除按钮的图标，showClear 为 true 时有效。传入 JSX 元素。
clearIcon.en-US: Custom icon of the clear button, effective when showClear is true. Takes a JSX element.

defaultOpen.en-US: Whether the panel is open by default.

defaultPickerValue.zh-CN: 默认面板日期。按内容比较，内容变化时面板回到该日期；每次渲染都传 `new Date()` 会被视为变化。
defaultPickerValue.en-US: Default panel date. Compared by content: when the content changes the panel moves back to it, so passing `new Date()` on every render counts as a change.

density.en-US: Density of the picker panel, one of `default` and `compact`.

disabledDate.zh-CN: 日期禁止判断方法，返回 true 时禁止该日期。options 含范围选择已选的 rangeStart、rangeEnd 与当前聚焦的输入框 rangeInputFocus；type 为 year 时以每年的 1 月 1 日调用，返回 true 时禁止该年。
disabledDate.en-US: Decides whether a date is disabled; returning true disables it. options carries the selected rangeStart and rangeEnd of a range and the focused input as rangeInputFocus. When type is year it is called with January 1 of each year, and returning true disables that year.

disabledTime.zh-CN: 时间禁止配置，返回值会透传给 TimePicker 组件。
disabledTime.en-US: Time restriction configuration. Its return value is passed through to the TimePicker.

dropdownClassName.en-US: Class name of the dropdown panel.

dropdownStyle.zh-CN: 下拉面板的内联样式，可传对象（键为 kebab-case）或字符串。
dropdownStyle.en-US: Inline style of the dropdown panel, as an object with kebab-case keys or as a string.

endDateOffset.zh-CN: type 为 dateRange 时，设置单击选择范围的结束日期。
endDateOffset.en-US: When type is dateRange, sets the end date of a one-click range selection.

endYear.zh-CN: 年份滚轮的结束年，需大于 startYear。默认为当前年后 100 年。
endYear.en-US: Last year of the year scroll panel, which must be greater than startYear. Defaults to 100 years after the current year.

format.zh-CN: 输入框中展示的日期字符串格式，默认值随 type 变化，见下方「日期时间格式」。
format.en-US: Date string format shown in the input. The default depends on type; see Date and Time Format below.

hideDisabledOptions.zh-CN: 隐藏禁止选择的时间选项。

inputStyle.zh-CN: 输入框的样式，可传对象（键为 kebab-case）或字符串。
inputStyle.en-US: Style of the input, as an object with kebab-case keys or as a string.

insetInput.zh-CN: 面板中是否嵌入输入框。可传布尔值，或传入 InsetInputProps 对象配置内嵌输入框的 placeholder。
insetInput.en-US: Whether the panel embeds input boxes. Takes a boolean, or an InsetInputProps object that sets the placeholders of the inset inputs.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 输入框内的标签，由 Form 字段注入；直接使用 DatePicker 时也会显示在输入框中。
insetLabel.en-US: Label shown in the input. The Form field injects it; used directly, DatePicker shows it in the input as well.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: 输入框内标签的元素 id，由 Form 字段注入，用于为输入框提供可访问名称。
insetLabelId.en-US: id of the label element inside the input. The Form field injects it to name the input.

leftSlot.zh-CN: 渲染左侧额外区域，传入 JSX 元素。
leftSlot.en-US: Renders an extra area on the left. Takes a JSX element.

max.zh-CN: multiple 为 true 时最多可选的日期数量，不传或为 null、undefined 时不限制。
max.en-US: Maximum number of dates that can be selected when multiple is true. Unlimited when it is not set, or is null or undefined.

motion.zh-CN: 是否开启面板展开的动画。
motion.en-US: Whether the panel animates when it opens.

multiple.zh-CN: 是否可以多选，仅支持 type 为 date。
multiple.en-US: Whether multiple dates can be selected. Only supports the date type.

needConfirm.zh-CN: 是否需要“确认选择”，仅 type 为 dateTime 或 dateTimeRange 时有效。
needConfirm.en-US: Whether a confirm step is needed. Only effective for the dateTime and dateTimeRange types.

onBlur.zh-CN: 面板关闭时的回调，范围选择时不推荐使用。只有点击外部关闭时 e 为原生 mousedown 事件，确认、选中日期、Esc 等其他关闭方式不传。
onBlur.en-US: Called when the panel closes; not recommended for range selection. e is the native mousedown event only when a click outside closes the panel; confirming, selecting a date, Esc and the other ways pass none.

onCancel.zh-CN: 取消选择时的回调，入参为上次确认的值，仅 type 为 dateTime 或 dateTimeRange 且 needConfirm 为 true 时有效。
onCancel.en-US: Called when the selection is cancelled, with the value of the last confirmed selection. Only effective for the dateTime and dateTimeRange types with needConfirm on.

onChange.zh-CN: 值变化时的回调。范围与多选时两个参数都是数组。
onChange.en-US: Called when the value changes. Both arguments are arrays for range and multiple selection.

onClear.zh-CN: 点击清除按钮时的回调。
onClear.en-US: Called when the clear button is clicked.

onClickOutSide.zh-CN: 弹出层展示时，在弹出层与触发器之外按下鼠标时的回调，参数为原生 mousedown 事件。
onClickOutSide.en-US: Called when a mousedown lands outside the popup and the trigger while the popup is open. It receives the native mousedown event.

onConfirm.zh-CN: 确认选择时的回调，入参为当前选择的值，仅 type 为 dateTime 或 dateTimeRange 且 needConfirm 为 true 时有效。
onConfirm.en-US: Called when the selection is confirmed, with the current value. Only effective for the dateTime and dateTimeRange types with needConfirm on.

onFocus.zh-CN: 获得焦点时的回调，范围选择时不推荐使用。e 为输入框的 focus 事件，或聚焦范围起始的触发器点击、按键事件；rangeType 只在范围输入框聚焦时有值。
onFocus.en-US: Called when the picker gets focus; not recommended for range selection. e is the focus event of an input, or the click or key press on the trigger that focused the range start; rangeType is set only when a range input gets focus.

onOpenChange.zh-CN: 面板显示或隐藏状态切换时的回调，入参为面板是否展开。
onOpenChange.en-US: Called when the panel opens or closes, with whether it is now open.

onPanelChange.zh-CN: 面板的年份或日期切换时的回调。
onPanelChange.en-US: Called when the year or date shown in the panel changes.

onPresetClick.zh-CN: 点击快捷选择按钮时的回调。
onPresetClick.en-US: Called when a preset button is clicked.

open.zh-CN: 面板显示或隐藏的受控属性，配合 onOpenChange 使用。
open.en-US: Controlled open state of the panel, used together with onOpenChange.

placeholder.zh-CN: 输入框的提示文字，范围类型可传数组。
placeholder.en-US: Placeholder of the input. A range type takes an array.

position.zh-CN: 浮层位置，可选值与 Popover 的 position 相同。
position.en-US: Popup position, with the same values as the position of Popover.

prefix.zh-CN: 输入框的前缀内容，传入 JSX 元素。
prefix.en-US: Prefix content of the input. Takes a JSX element.

prefixCls.zh-CN: 根元素与面板的类名前缀，一般无需修改。
prefixCls.en-US: Class name prefix of the root element and the panel, usually left unchanged.

presetPosition.zh-CN: 快捷选择面板的位置，可选值：left、right、top、bottom。
presetPosition.en-US: Position of the preset panel, one of left, right, top and bottom.

presets.zh-CN: 日期时间快捷选择。start 与 end 可以是函数，函数每次打开面板时求值。
presets.en-US: Preset shortcuts. start and end can be functions, which are evaluated each time the panel opens.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 指示浏览器是否应滚动文档以显示新聚焦的元素，作用于组件内的 focus 方法。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether the browser scrolls the document to show a newly focused element. Applies to the focus method inside the component.

rangeSeparator.zh-CN: 范围类型输入框的日期分隔符，字符串解析同样使用它。
rangeSeparator.en-US: Separator between the two dates in a range input. String parsing uses it as well.

rangeSeparatorNode.zh-CN: 范围类型输入框分隔符的渲染节点，仅影响界面展示，字符串解析仍使用 rangeSeparator。
rangeSeparatorNode.en-US: Node rendered as the range separator. It only affects the display; string parsing still uses rangeSeparator.

ref.zh-CN: 根元素，携带 open、close、focus、blur 方法。
ref.en-US: The root element, which carries the open, close, focus and blur methods.

renderDate.zh-CN: 自定义日期的显示内容，入参为日（数字）与完整日期字符串，返回 JSX 元素。
renderDate.en-US: Customizes the content of a date. It receives the day number and the full date string, and returns a JSX element.

renderFullDate.zh-CN: 自定义整个日期格子的渲染内容，入参为日（数字）、完整日期字符串与日期状态。
renderFullDate.en-US: Customizes the whole date cell. It receives the day number, the full date string and the day status.

rightSlot.zh-CN: 渲染右侧额外区域，传入 JSX 元素。
rightSlot.en-US: Renders an extra area on the right. Takes a JSX element.

showClear.en-US: Whether the clear button is shown.

size.en-US: Size of the input, one of small, default and large.

spacing.zh-CN: 浮层与触发器之间的距离。
spacing.en-US: Distance between the popup and the trigger.

startDateOffset.zh-CN: type 为 dateRange 时，设置单击选择范围的开始日期。
startDateOffset.en-US: When type is dateRange, sets the start date of a one-click range selection.

startYear.zh-CN: 年份滚轮的开始年，默认为当前年前 100 年。
startYear.en-US: First year of the year scroll panel. Defaults to 100 years before the current year.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止弹出层上的点击事件冒泡。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether clicks on the popup stop propagating.

style.zh-CN: 根元素的样式，可传对象（键为 kebab-case）或字符串。
style.en-US: Style of the root element, as an object with kebab-case keys or as a string.

syncSwitchMonth.zh-CN: 范围选择时，两个面板是否同步切换月份。
syncSwitchMonth.en-US: In range selection, whether the two panels switch months together.

timePickerOpts.zh-CN: 传给时间面板的参数：use12Hours、hourStep、minuteStep、secondStep、defaultIsAM、scrollItemProps，含义见 TimePicker 的 API。格式、值和 onChange 由面板设置。
timePickerOpts.en-US: Options for the time panel: use12Hours, hourStep, minuteStep, secondStep, defaultIsAM and scrollItemProps, as described in the TimePicker API. The panel sets the format, the value and onChange.

timeZone.zh-CN: 时区，值与面板日期按该时区解释和展示。字符串为 IANA 时区名，如 Asia/Shanghai；数字会原样传给 date-fns-tz 的 utcToZonedTime。
timeZone.en-US: Time zone in which the value and panel dates are read and shown. A string is an IANA time zone name such as Asia/Shanghai; a number is passed as is to utcToZonedTime of date-fns-tz.

topSlot.zh-CN: 渲染顶部额外区域，传入 JSX 元素。
topSlot.en-US: Renders an extra area at the top. Takes a JSX element.

triggerRender.zh-CN: 自定义触发器的渲染函数，只调用一次。入参为触发器属性，其中每个键都是响应式的，需在返回的 JSX 中读取。
triggerRender.en-US: Renders a custom trigger. It is called once. The props it receives are reactive, so read them inside the returned JSX.

type.en-US: Type, one of date, dateRange, dateTime, dateTimeRange, month, monthRange and year.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，仅影响展示样式，success 与 default 样式相同。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status, which only affects the display style. success looks the same as default.

weekStartsOn.zh-CN: 以周几作为每周第一天，0 代表周日，1 代表周一，以此类推。
weekStartsOn.en-US: Day of the week that starts each week: 0 is Sunday, 1 is Monday, and so on.

yearAndMonthOpts.zh-CN: 透传给年月选择器的其他参数。list、onSelect、selectedIndex 与 type 由面板设置，不接受传入。
yearAndMonthOpts.en-US: Other options passed to the year and month picker. list, onSelect, selectedIndex and type are set by the panel and are not accepted.

open.zh-CN: 展开面板。受控的 open 优先，受控时 open 不改变面板的可见性。
open.en-US: Opens the panel. A controlled open takes precedence; when it is controlled, open does not change the visibility.

close.zh-CN: 关闭面板。受控的 open 优先，受控时 close 不改变面板的可见性。
close.en-US: Closes the panel. A controlled open takes precedence; when it is controlled, close does not change the visibility.

focus.zh-CN: 聚焦输入框。范围类型默认聚焦开始框，传入 `'rangeEnd'` 时聚焦结束框；开启 insetInput 且面板打开时聚焦面板内的输入框。
focus.en-US: Focuses the input. A range type focuses the start input by default, or the end input with `'rangeEnd'`. With insetInput and the panel open, it focuses the input inside the panel.
